position_overview:
About

Propeller is on a mission to take the guesswork out of moving dirt - reducing wasted fuel, time, and money. We do this through the power of maps.

Our customers use Propeller's integrated hardware and software products to capture accurate 3D versions of their worksites. With over 50,000 worksites worldwide using Propeller's smart survey technology, we empower project teams to map, measure, and manage site activity.

Propeller empowers everyone to approach, own, and solve problems creatively. We're data nerds who care about impact, honesty, and each other. We take pride in being a great place to work. We are proud to be recipients ofBI Group'sExcellence in Customer Experience award andInspiring Workplacesof Australasia, being recognized as aFast CompanyandBuiltInBest Place to Work. You can learn more about us onGlassdoor.

Your Mission

We're looking for a detail-oriented, organised, and proactive Order Ops Specialist to support our sales operations and commercial workflows. In this fully remote role, you'll generate quotes, maintain HubSpot CRM hygiene, prepare deals, and support order provisioning. You'll work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth execution and accurate data management.

You'll bring a solid understanding of commercial principles, including margins and revenue recognition, and thrive in a fast-paced environment that calls for responsiveness, adaptability, and close attention to detail.

Your
key_responsibilities:
- Quote Management & Adjustments: Generate, update, and adjust commercial quotes accurately based on deal requirements.
- HubSpot CRM Maintenance: Maintain CRM organization and database hygiene to ensure pipeline data and deal records are accurate and up-to-date.
- Deal Preparation: Prepare deals and documentation for internal review, approval, and closing.
- Commercial Analysis: Apply commercial basics (e.g., margins, revenue rules) to review quote structures and deal terms.
- Order Provisioning: Perform light order provisioning tasks to ensure smooth handoffs and fulfillment.
- Cross-Functional Communication: Collaborate asynchronously and synchronously with team members using Slack and Google Workspace.

Your Skills
- Attention to Detail: Meticulous accuracy when working with quotes, pricing models, and data entry.
- Organization & Responsiveness: Excellent time-management skills with the ability to manage priorities and respond promptly in a remote setting.
- Proactivity: Strong initiative to identify missing information, streamline processes, and solve problems independently.
- Adaptability & Patience: Ability to pivot when deal parameters change while maintaining composure and consistency.

Nice-to-haves:
- Experience with HubSpot CRM (managing deals, contacts, and quotes).
- Proficiency in Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail).
- Working knowledge of Slack for daily team communication and collaboration.
- HMO gold medical insurance
- Paid vacation and sick leave
- Paid parental leave policies
- Annual professional development budget and leave
- The opportunity to take part in our mentorship program
- WFH equipment provided
- Monthly WFH allowance
- Employee share options
